title: France – Assembly of metal structures – PROJET RNG – NATION PHASE 1 – Lot T05 : Travaux d’aménagement dans le cadre de la rénovation et la modernisation des quais du RER A à Nation
description: La gare de Nation représente l’un des exemples les plus remarquables des grandes gares centrales de la ligne A du RER. Elle est construite sous la place de la Nation et constitue en 1969, la première gare du tronçon central parisien à avoir été réalisée. Après près de 40 ans d’existence, la gare présente des amé-nagements toujours très proches des volontés de conception d’origine. L’objectif du projet RNG (Rénovation des Gares) à Nation, consiste en une rénovation totale du point d’arrêt comprenant : - Le désamiantage de certaines parties d’ouvrage (gaines de ventilation et colles à carrelages) - La dépose des aménagement latéraux en piédroits - La dépose des ouvrages métalliques situés sur les quais (porte à faux, faux plafonds) - La réalisation d’une étanchéité type SEL A en voûte - La réalisation d’une peinture complète en voûte - La réalisation d’ouvrages architecturaux sur les piédroits intégrant l’ensemble des services desti-nés aux voyageurs - La reprise des sols de quais - L’aménagement des couloirs d’accès aux quais (en partie) Le présent marché concerne notamment : - les travaux de fabrication et de pose de vêtures métalliques microperforée intégrant un traitement acoustique sur les piédroits des quais, y compris la structure qui soutient tous ces ouvrages, - les travaux de fabrication et de pose d’arceaux supports d’équipements, - les travaux de fabrication et de pose des assises, - la réfection des sols et des rigoles des quais et accès quai, y compris cuvelage au sol par endroits, - le raccordement des réseaux d’évacuation des eaux des quais en sous-quai, - la rénovation de locaux techniques niveau quai.

This is not a Request for Quotation (RFQ) or an Invitation for Bid (IFB), nor is it to be construed as a commitment by the U. S. Government to form a binding contract. Parties that respond will not be paid for the information submitted. The Air Force is hereby requesting capability statements and other information from interested sources. General Information: The Air Force Test Center at Edwards AFB, CA is in the process of determining the acquisition strategy to obtain information from potential eligible and interested contractors for Lease/Rental of Pre-Engineered/Prefabricated modular buildings. The purpose of this modular building is to provide the 412 MXG additional space to flight equipment needed to meet mission requirements. Please see the Statement of Work (SOW) for more information. The AFTC anticipates awarding a contract under the associated North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) is 332311 with a standard size of 750 employees and a Product Service Code (PSC) of 5410. If sufficient responsible and capable sources are identified, a formal RFQ will be posted on GSA.gov. Interested parties are requested to furnish a capability statement detailing their capabilities to provide these services, include highlights of experience on similar government or commercial contracts/agreements. In addition, please indicate business size (Large or Small), CAGE code/DUNS, provide a list of any contracts or other agreements similar in nature, the program/project name, contract number or other identifier, administering office/address, and the point of contact with the current telephone number. Please provide your response in Microsoft Word or a Microsoft Word compatible format. Submissions should be to the point and no more than 10 double space pages. Responses shall not be proprietary and will be unclassified. Interested vendors should submit responses no later than 7 September 2026 6:00 AM Pacific Daylight Time (PDT). Small Business sources responding should state their business size status based on the NAICS referenced above. Replies to this RFI should be sent via email to Abel Alcantar, Contracting Specialist, AFTC/PZZG at abel.alcantar.1@us.af.mil

title: D--Notice of Intent to Sole Source-FLOW-3D Software
description: The U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) intends to award a sole source contract for FLOW 3D HYDRO a computational fluid dynamics (CFD) software. This notice is issued in accordance with Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) 12.102(a), which specifies that Part 12 acquisition procedures apply to commercial products and services and shall take precedence where inconsistencies exist with other FAR parts. The USGS Eastern Ecological Science Center relies on FLOW 3D HYDRO�a computational fluid dynamics (CFD) software�to support ongoing and future hydraulic engineering and fish passage research. Continuity of maintenance and technical support is required to ensure uninterrupted access to software updates, corrections, and assistance, enabling timely capture, processing, and dissemination of scientific data. The current maintenance contract expires September 30, 2026, and renewal is necessary to sustain operational capability and mission objectives. Flow Science, Inc. is the exclusive provider and licensor for FLOW-3D software and maintenance. They maintain sole proprietary rights to the creation, development, distribution, and maintenance for this software, and there are no other authorized distributors available. There are no resellers in the marketplace. This procurement is being conducted under commercial acquisition procedures per RFO 12.102(a), as the services required meet the definition of commercial services under FAR 2.101. The NAICS code is 513210 Software Publishers. The size standard is $47.0. Period of Performance: One year with three option periods. Place of Performance: Woods Hole, Maine 02543 Anticipated award date: 9/7/2026 This notice is not a request for competitive quotes. However, interested parties may submit capability statements demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of on FLOW 3D HYDRO Capability statements must be submitted by the date and time specified in this notice and must provide sufficient detail for Government consideration. Responses shall be emailed to: mindie_dixon@ios.doi.gov.

title: 6515--Weight-Based Inventory Management System (WBIMS ) Supply Cabinets and Software Brand name or equal to PAR Excellence Systems Inc.
description: THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION ONLY. The purpose of this notice is to obtain information regarding the availability and capability of all qualified sources to fulfil a potential requirement. The responses received from interested contractors will assist the Government in determining the appropriate acquisition method. The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Network Contracting Office (NCO) 20, is conducting market research to identify potential sources for: VISN 20 requires a Weight-Based Inventory Supply System (WBIMS) brand name or equal to PAR Excellence. This procurement will include supply cabinets, related parts, and Software Licenses for various facilities throughout VISN 20. Supply Cabinets, parts and Software must work with the integrated system currently owned by VISN 20. Vendor will ensure system is fully operational and ensure system communications are intact. Participating Locations: Alaska VA Healthcare System: 1201 North Muldoon Road, Anchorage, AK 99504 Eugene Health Care Center: 3355 Chad Dr., Eugene, OR 97408 VA Portland Health Care System: 3710 SW U.S. Veterans Hospital Road, Portland, OR 97239 Roseburg VA Health Care System: 913 NW Garden Valley Blvd., Roseburg, OR 97471 VA Southern Oregon Rehabilitation Center: 8495 Crater Lake Hwy., White City, OR 97503 VA Puget Sound Health Care System - American Lake Division: 9600 Veterans Dr Southwest, Tacoma, WA 98493 VA Puget Sound Health Care System: 1660 S. Columbian Way, Seattle, WA 98108 Mann-Grandstaff VA Medical Center: 4815 N. Assembly Street, Spokane, WA 99205 Jonathan M. Wainwright Memorial VA Medical Center: 77 Wainwright Drive, Walla Walla, WA 99362 Specifications for WBIMS: Must be weight based Must be easily calibrated and accurate Will provide real time visibility to secondary inventory locations Must be able to interface with GIP package in IFCAP Must be capable of tracking, adjusting, and reporting comprehensive real time information pertaining to the inventory of a secondary location Depletion of stock will trigger pick tickets based on PAR levels, Re-order points, and Emergency Stock Levels Software & Software Licensing must be intuitive and easy to train on Software & Software Licensing must be able to utilize multiple users with different levels of permissions Must be able to handle a wide range of products based on size, thickness, and weight Must work with the current VHA IT system Locations may be on site at the main facility campuses (listed above) or at one of VISN 20 s Community Based Outpatient Clinic (CBOC). Map and locations for Medical Centers and Clinics within the V20 Northwest Network can be found at the following link: https://www.va.gov/directory/guide/region.asp?ID=1020. Potential candidates having the capabilities necessary to provide the above stated requirement are invited to respond to this Request for Information via e-mail to Gregory Watson at Gregory,Watson2@va.gov no later than 7 September 2026, 06:00 PST. No telephone inquiries will be accepted. RESPONSES SHOULD INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING INFORMATION: company name, address, and business size; point of contact name, phone number, e-mail address. NAICS Code 334519 is applicable to determine business size standard. Any questions or concerns may also be directed to Gregory Watson via e-mail.

title: 140th COS Advantor upgrade requirement
description: This is a Notice of Intent to Sole Source and not a Request for Quotation. The 108TH Wing intends to award a sole-source, firm-fixed-price contract to Advantor Systems Corporation, CAGE# 1S063, for the upgrade and integration of an Intrusion Detection System (IDS) and Access Control System (ACS) for the Alert Area in Building 3322, for their Cyber Operations Squadron. This action is being conducted under the authority of RFO FAR 6.103-1: Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements,10 U.S.C 3204(a)(1) The 108th is required to procure sole source to Advantor. Per AFI 31-101: The Advantor Alarm System is the only alarm/security system that the 87th SFS can use to monitor IDS Alarm Activity on JB MDL. In addition: A. AFI 31-101 prohibits the tenant (108th Security Forces) from monitoring two separate IDS alarm systems simultaneously and all the existing infrastructure is already Advantor. B. The Existing IBDSS-East IDS Maintenance Contract managed by the AFSFC is for Advantor only, this includes having Advantor certified technicians on site for repairs and inspections. Advantor Alarm Panels are the only brand compatible with the JB MDL Advantor IBDSS Servers that are in use at JB MDL.

title: Notice of Intent to Sole Source
description: This notice is being published in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO) Subpart 5.101 requiring dissemination of information for proposed contract actions. This is a notice of intent to award a sole source contract and is not a request for competitive quotes/proposals. The statutory authority for this sole source procurement is prescribed by RFO 12.201-1. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) intends to negotiate and award a sole-source purchase order to Mobile Communications America, Inc. for the SSMC Emergency Radios as described below . The anticipated award date is September 24, 2026. Description of supplies or services required to meet agency needs The Silver Spring Metro Center (SSMC) Campus emergency radios, radio programming, batteries, and one year maintenance agreement for WAVE control box, repeaters, and panic buttons. The SSMC emergency radio network facilitates emergency communication amongst all Line/Staff Offices at the SSMC Campus. The associated North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this procurement is 334220 (Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing). Notice of Capability Statement Consideration: This notice is not a request for competitive quotes. However, any responsible source that believes it can meet the government's requirement may submit a capability statement for quote. Capability statements or quotes received prior to the closing date will be considered by the agency solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed requirement based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government.

title: Fast Electronic Spectrum analyzer
description: The National Research Council Canada requires a fast electronic spectrum analyzer to support quantum optics, ultrafast photonics, and high-speed optical/electronic measurements. The instrument will be used to characterize radio-frequency spectra, noise, and modulation signals from laboratory photodetectors and related measurement systems. The analyzer must provide sufficient bandwidth and measurement capability to support experiments involving fast optical pulses, high-speed detectors, and radio-frequency readout electronics.

title: APN_CONSTRUCT NEW MAINTENANCE BUILDINGS (MDB PROJECT) PETAWAWA, ON
description: Advance Procurement Notice Construct New Maintenance Buildings (MDB Project) PETAWAWA, ON (with Security Requirements) PURPOSE OF THIS ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform Design-Builders of an upcoming contract opportunity at CFB Petawawa. The purpose of this APN is to allow Design-Builders to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested Design-Builders to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Description of the Project and Services It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND. APN Number: 86885 Title: Construct New Maintenance Buildings Approximate Estimate: $95M Anticipated Posting: October 2026 Description This project includes the design and construction of 5 new maintenance buildings at CFB Petawawa and associated ancillary site works and utilities. These facilities are required to address operational capability and infrastructure deficiencies across multiple units. Each building will be approximately 1700 m2 and will be 50% warehouse function for storage and equipment management, 40% office function for administrative and command spaces, classrooms and training facilities and 10% workshop function to support unit equipment servicing. It is anticipated this project will be delivered through a Modified Design-Build (MDB) delivery model.  Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements To be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The required security clearance anticipated for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS) Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing Design-Builders early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, Design-Builders that intend to submit a proposal on this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, Contractors and Consultants are asked to quote the following information, among other things: - Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number 86885; and - Level of clearance requested to be sponsored for. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the Design-Builders to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a Design Builder: a)  has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation (Contract number(s) listed on their request for sponsorship) being advertised on MERX;  b)  has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package; and c)  has submitted a proposal. DCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Stephen Recoskie Team Leader, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada PCO@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process and does not provide any representations or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, the proponent agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to the proponent for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated sponsorship process.    Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.

title: Greece – Advertising and marketing services – Έγκριση διενέργειας διαγωνισμού άνω των ορίων για την Παροχή Υπηρεσιών Υλοποίησης της Πράξης EpirusMedEye (MIS 6010984) «Enhancing Healthcare Access in Municipality of Dropull through Greece-Albania Cooperation Background» του Προγράμματος «Interreg VI-A IPA Greece Albania» Συνολικού Προϋπολογισμού: €320.886,00 (συμπ. ΦΠΑ) σε 2 τμηματα
description: Αντικείμενο της σύμβασης είναι η παροχή εξειδικευμένων υπηρεσιών υποστήριξης προς την Επιτελική Δομή ΕΣΠΑ του Υπουργείου Υγείας για την υλοποίηση συγκεκριμένων παραδοτέων της Πράξης «EpirusMedEye», τα οποία εμπίπτουν στις αρμοδιότητες και τις υποχρεώσεις που έχει αναλάβει η Υπηρεσία στο πλαίσιο της συμμετοχής της στην εν λόγω Πράξη. Οι προς ανάθεση υπηρεσίες αφορούν αφενός δράσεις επικοινωνίας, δημοσιότητας και διοργάνωσης εκδηλώσεων και αφετέρου δράσεις τεχνικής υποστήριξης, εκπαίδευσης και αξιολόγησης υπηρεσιών τηλεϊατρικής, και διαρθρώνονται σε δύο (2) τμήματα. Ειδικότερα, η σύμβαση περιλαμβάνει την υποστήριξη της Υπηρεσίας για την υλοποίηση των κατωτέρω παραδοτέων της Πράξης «EpirusMedEye», όπως αυτά αναλυτικά περιγράφονται και εξειδικεύονται ως προς το φυσικό αντικείμενο στο Παράρτημα Ι Η διάρκεια της Σύμβασης (και κάθε τμήματος αυτής) ορίζεται από την υπογραφή της έως τις 12/10/2027 σύμφωνα με το Τεχνικό Δελτίο του Έργου και το χρονοδιάγραμμα των υπηρεσιών/παραδοτέων του ορίζεται στο ΠΑΡΑΡΤΗΜΑ Ι. Σε περίπτωση παράτασης της διάρκειας υλοποίησης της Πράξης «EpirusMedEye» (MIS 6010984) από τα αρμόδια όργανα του Προγράμματος Interreg VI-A IPA Greece–Albania 2021–2027, η Αναθέτουσα Αρχή δύναται να τροποποιήσει μονομερώς τη σύμβαση ως προς τη διάρκειά της και το χρονοδιάγραμμα υλοποίησης του αντικειμένου αυτής. Η διάρκεια της σύμβασης παρατείνεται για χρονικό διάστημα ίσο με την εγκεκριμένη παράταση της Πράξης και έως 31/12/2029 κατ’ ανώτατο όριο, ενώ οι προθεσμίες εκτέλεσης των επιμέρους υπηρεσιών και υποβολής των παραδοτέων αναπροσαρμόζονται αναλόγως, χωρίς καμία αύξηση του οικονομικού αντικειμένου και σύμφωνα με τις προβλέψεις του ΠΑΡΑΡΤΗΜΑΤΟΣ Ι. Οι προσφέροντες δύνανται να υποβάλουν προσφορά για ένα ή και για τα δύο Τμήματα. Η αξιολόγηση και η ανάθεση πραγματοποιούνται αυτοτελώς ανά Τμήμα. Δεν επιτρέπονται εναλλακτικές προσφορές. Οι υποβαλλόμενες προσφορές ισχύουν και δεσμεύουν τους οικονομικούς φορείς για διάστημα έξι (6) μηνών από την επομένη της διενέργειας του διαγωνισμού.

title: Q301--Neural Stem Cell Therapy for Spinal Cord cGLP Support Intent to Sole Source
description: The Veteran s Administration (VA) Office of Research and Development, Regional Procurement Office East in Pittsburgh, PA intends to negotiate on a sole source basis with Virscio, Inc. based in New Haven, CT on behalf of the VA San Diego Healthcare System. The requirement is to provide current Good Laboratory Practice (cGLP)-compliant histopathology services supporting a nonclinical toxicology study evaluating the safety of intraspinal administration of H9 spinal cord neural stem cells (H9-scNSCs) in a cervical hemi-contusion spinal cord injury model in athymic nude rats. The services include tissue processing, paraffin embedding, histologic sectioning, hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining, immunohistochemistry, digital slide scanning, pathology evaluation by an American College of Veterinary Pathologists (ACVP)-board-certified veterinary pathologist, quality assurance, and preparation of a final pathology report suitable for inclusion in an FDA Investigational New Drug (IND) application Specific Tasks and Deliverables: 1. Study Support for compliance with GLP documentation requirements SPECIFIC TASK: The Contractor shall provide scientific and administrative support necessary to execute the histopathology portion of the nonclinical safety study. Support shall include study coordination, protocol development and refinement, scheduling personnel and meetings with sponsor, sample tracking throughout each process, communication with the Sponsor, quality oversight of GLP procedures and documentation, and coordination of study activities through completion of the final report. DELIVERABLE: Specimen inventory log including the animal number, treatment group, tissue identification, date received, received by, condition upon receipt, and storage location within 1 week or receipt of tissues. description: Action: Sources Sought Notice for Market Research Agency: Department of the Army Office: MICC-Fort Stewart Notice ID: W9124M-26-R-ICIDS Classification Code: J - Maintenance, repair & rebuilding of equipment Product Service Code (PSC): J063 - Maintenance, Repair, and Rebuilding of Equipment- Alarm, Signal, and Security Detection Systems NAICS Code: 561621 - Security Systems Services (Except Locksmiths) Size Standard: $25.0 Million 1. Synopsis This is a Sources Sought notice for market research purposes only. This is not a solicitation for proposals, proposal abstracts, or quotations. The purpose of this notice is to obtain information regarding the availability and capability of qualified sources to perform the services described below. The Government is seeking to identify qualified vendors, particularly small businesses, who are capable of meeting the Government's requirements. The Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this notice or to otherwise pay for the information solicited. The information received will be used to determine the appropriate acquisition strategy for a future procurement. 2. Requirement Description The Mission and Installation Contracting Command (MICC) at Fort Stewart, GA, on behalf of the 3d Infantry Division (3ID) G2, has a requirement for non-personal services to provide comprehensive maintenance, emergency repair, and cybersecurity sustainment for the Government's existing DAQ Electronics Starwatch� Security Management System (SMS) and Integrated Commercial Intrusion Detection System (ICIDS). The place of performance is Fort Stewart and Hunter Army Airfield, Georgia. The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month base year with three (3) 12-month option periods, projected to begin on or around the first quarter of Fiscal Year 2027. 3. Mandatory Requirements This requirement includes two (2) mandatory, non-negotiable constraints. Interested vendors MUST be able to meet both requirements at the time of proposal submission for any future solicitation. DAQ Electronics OEM Certification: The contractor must be an authorized and certified partner/integrator for DAQ Electronics security products. All technicians performing work under the contract must hold current factory certifications from DAQ Electronics to service proprietary Starwatch� SMS and ICIDS hardware and software. Facility Security Clearance: The contractor must possess a valid Top Secret (TS) Facility Clearance at the time of proposal submission, and all personnel performing on-site work must have, at a minimum, an adjudicated Secret clearance, with the Program Manager and key technicians requiring TS/SCI eligibility. This is required due to the necessity for unescorted access to Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIFs). 4. Requested Information from Industry Interested parties are requested to provide a capabilities statement package (not to exceed 5 pages) that demonstrates the ability to perform the services described herein. The package must be submitted via email to the points of contact listed in Section 5 of this notice. Please include the following information in your response: Company Information: Company Name, Address, and Point of Contact (including email and phone number). UEI Number and CAGE Code. Socio-economic status under the specified NAICS code 561621 (e.g., Small Business, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business, HUBZone, 8(a), Woman-Owned Small Business, etc.). Capability Questions (Must be answered): Question 1: Can your company perform the services described in the requirement overview (Section 2)? Please provide a brief narrative describing your company�s experience maintaining and repairing ICIDS systems, specifically the DAQ Electronics Starwatch� platform. Question 2: Does your company currently hold a valid Top Secret (TS) Facility Clearance? Question 3: If this requirement is set aside for small businesses, will your company be able to perform at least 50 percent of the cost of the contract performance with its own employees, in accordance with FAR 52.219-14, Limitations on Subcontracting? 5. Submission Details All responses must be submitted via email no later than September 7, 2026, at 10:00 AM Eastern Standard Time. Primary Point of Contact: SSG Mykola Iudin Contract Specialist Mykola.iudin.mil@army.mil Secondary Point of Contact: MSG Keandre D. Malone Contracting Officer Keandre.d.malone.mil@army.mil Disclaimer: This Sources Sought is issued for market research purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation. title: Wrench
description: Double-end box wrench is constructed from alloy steel with a satin finish and features standard heads set at a 15-degree offset for improved access in confined spaces. It is designed in SAE sizing with head sizes of 1-1/2 inch and 1-5/8 inch and includes rounded openings on both ends. The wrench has a straight, one-piece silver handle and a standard-length body measuring 17 inches overall, with an overall width of 3-17/64 inches. Head thickness measures 39/64 inch on one end and 5/8 inch on the other. The tool is not insulated, non-sparking, non-magnetic, ratcheting, or reversing, but it is corrosion resistant and tether capable. The wrench weighs 3.31 pounds.

title: Notice of Intent: Relocation of a Thermo Fisher Scientific Scios 2 FIB-SEM
description: NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE Contracting Opportunities Announcement Type: Special Notice Announcement Number: NIST-NOI-26-02512 Subject: Relocation of a Thermo Fisher Scientific Scios 2 FIB-SEM Introduction This is a notice of intent, not a request for a quotation. A solicitation document will not be issued, and quotations will not be requested. Purpose The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) intends to negotiate a firm-fixed-price purchase order on a sole-source basis with FEI Company, a Thermo Fisher Scientific subsidiary, located in Hillsboro, Oregon. The purpose of this acquisition is to decommission, relocate, reinstall, and return to operational condition a NIST-owned Thermo Fisher Scientific Scios 2 Focused Ion Beam�Scanning Electron Microscope (FIB-SEM) at the NIST Gaithersburg, Maryland campus. The system will continue to support research activities within NIST�s Material Measurement Laboratory (MML). Authority This acquisition is being conducted using the procedures at FAR Part 12 � Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this acquisition is 334516 �Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing, with a small business size standard of 1000 Employees. Description The Material Measurement Laboratory (MML) at the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) conducts research and measurement science activities in support of NIST�s mission to advance measurement capabilities, promote innovation, and support U.S. industry. As part of these efforts, MML conducts materials characterization and analysis using advanced microscopy and related instrumentation to investigate the structure, composition, and properties of materials at microscopic and nanoscale dimensions. Among the specialized instrumentation utilized by MML are dual-beam focused ion beam scanning electron (FIB-SEM) microscopes. These systems integrate focused ion beam milling and scanning electron microscopy capabilities within a single platform, enabling researchers to perform advanced materials characterization and related analytical activities. The equipment represents a significant scientific asset supporting ongoing and planned NIST research programs. MML currently operates a Thermo Fisher Scientific Scios 2 FIB-SEM within an existing NIST facility. Due to changing programmatic and space-utilization requirements, NIST has determined that the instrument must be relocated from its current room to another room on the same floor within the existing building. The relocation is necessary to accommodate evolving programmatic needs and optimize the use of the laboratory space while maintaining the instrument�s availability for continued research and measurement activities. Because the Scios 2 is a highly specialized and precision scientific instrument, its relocation requires appropriate planning, handling, transportation, positioning, installation, and verification to minimize the risk of damage to the equipment and ensure that it remains operational following the move. The work must account for the instrument�s specialized configuration and the requirements of the existing laboratory environment. Accordingly, NIST requires the services of a qualified contractor with the necessary technical expertise, equipment, personnel, and experience to safely relocate the existing Thermo Fisher Scientific Scios 2 FIB-SEM from its current location to the designated room on the same floor and return the system to an operational condition. The relocation shall be performed in accordance with the requirements specified in this document and coordinated with designated NIST personnel to minimize disruption to ongoing laboratory operations. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS The Contractor shall provide the following: CLIN 0001: Move of Scios 2 FIB-SEM Description: Contractor shall de-install the Scios 2, move it to another laboratory on the same floor of the current building, and then re-install the Scios 2, and verify that it meets the factory specifications of performance. Quantity: one (1) The MCP gate shall: � Employ a nanosecond high-voltage pulse to gate the MCP detector in our CAMECA LEAP 4000 X-Si. � The MCP gate will decrease the voltage on the MCPs by a sufficient amount that the MCPs are not saturated. In this way, it is possible to maintain a high sensitivity, even near very intense bunches, which are �gated off� and would otherwise saturate our detector. � The gate pulse should be applied such that it does not affect the electric fields inside the flight tube of the TOF mass spectrometer. � Enable the detector to act as a fast shutter to ignore specific signals in a defined TOF window relative to the trigger pulse (t0). � Allow fast switching of MCP amplification, thus allowing NIST to choose to ignore signals that arrive in a specific time window following the trigger signal in the TOF mass spectrometry measurement required for performing atom probe tomography. � Accommodate pulse frequency rates from 100 kHz to 200 kHz. Technical Specifications: A. MCP Gate Hardware: The MCP gate shall include hardware that meets the following requirements: � The MCP gate module upgrade shall be installed on an existing CAMECA LEAP 4000 X-Si instrument (S/N 5020) at NIST Boulder Laboratories. � The MCP gate module upgrade shall include any necessary hardware including high voltage supply, timing electronics, cables, etc. NIST will supply a trigger puylse from a mode-locked laser and will supply a digital delay generator for moving the gated time window. � The MCP gate module upgrade shall allow for gating our TOF mass spectrometry signal to ignore specific timing events of NIST choosing (e.g. events caused from scattering of electrons or ions in the vacuum chamber of the APT microscope). B. MCP Gate LEAP Integration � Control and operation of the MCP gate shall be fully integrated into the existing CAMECA LEAP 4000 X-Si instrument and controlled through a digital delay generator (supplied by NIST). C. Warranty and Service � One (1) year warranty (to cover parts, labor, and travel) shall be included with the MCP gate module. The warranty shall cover the entire system and include on-site, telephone, and e-mail support. All costs including parts, labor, travel, and other expenses necessary to repair the system (including all Contractor supplied hardware) shall be borne solely by the contractor at no additional cost to the U.S. Government as long as the existing factory warranty for the LEAP microscope is in place and active. Warranty start date is the date of site acceptance. D. Delivery � Upon successful factory testing, the contractor shall be responsible for delivering the MCP gate module to its final location in a NIST-designated laboratory. � The contractor shall schedule all visits to NIST with the COR at least 1 week before arriving at the site. E. Contractor Supplied Materials � The contractor shall supply all parts, hardware, equipment, and labor required to perform the tasks listed. Sole Source Determination The requirement is considered sole source because the equipment is an existing Thermo Fisher Scientific Scios 2 FIB-SEM that is maintained under a factory service agreement, and the required relocation involves specialized decommissioning, handling, reinstallation, and performance verification procedures specific to the manufacturer's equipment. Thermo Fisher Scientific possesses the proprietary technical knowledge, manufacturer's procedures, specialized expertise, and equipment necessary to safely decommission and relocate the Scios 2 and subsequently restore the system to its required operating condition. The relocation involves the disconnection and reconnection of complex electrical and vacuum systems, as well as the proper handling and alignment of precision components that are critical to the microscope's performance. title: Synthetic Data Generation for Property and Passenger Screening
description: The Office of Procurement Operations (OPO) on behalf of the Office of Science and Technology Directorate (S&T) hereby issues this notice of intent to award a sole source procurement. DHS OPO intends to solicit and award support services as a sole source contract to Cignal LLC, 7991 E Back Mountain Road, Reedsville, Pennsylvania 17084-8823. This is a notice of intent to solicit and award a sole source contract under the authority of FAR 6.103-1 �Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements�. The relevant NAICS code is 541715 Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology), with a size standard of 1,000 employees. The PSC code is AJ12, General Science and Technology R&D Services; General science and technology; Applied Research. Summary of the requirement Background The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Science and Technology Directorate (S&T) Screening at Speed (SaS) program pursues transformative research and development (R&D) activities that support a future vision for increasing aviation security effectiveness from curb to gate while dramatically reducing wait times and improving the passenger experience. Building and testing reliable machine vision Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems requires access to large amounts of high-quality, labeled data. For homeland security applications, there are several barriers to getting this data: 1) threats are constantly evolving; 2) tailored sensor data (particularly threat data) is expensive to acquire; 3) manual annotation is time consuming; and 4) security datasets are massive and difficult to share. To address these challenges, Cignal created the Cignal Engine prototype which is a suite of simulation and multi-spectral data lifecycle tools to support machine vision AI Development and Operations (DevOps). This technology requires further maturation before transition to the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) can be initiated. Scope Cignal shall further develop its prototype and demonstrate software tools that support synthetic data generation suitable for public algorithm development (non-sensitive) and Government development, testing, and evaluation (sensitive). It is anticipated that Cignal will collaborate with potential end users at S&T, TSA, and elsewhere to validate tools and generated images for suitability for machine learning development, training, testing, and evaluation over the course of the contract. Place of Performance: The primary place of performance will be at contractor facilities. Period of Performance: 12 month base period, one 12 month option periods Market research has determined that only Cignal can support the continued maturation of the technology that Cignal developed under previous efforts for DHS S&T. A determination by the Government not to compete based upon responses to this notice is solely at the discretion of the Government. This is a notice of the intent to award a sole source contract. It is published for informational purposes only and not a request for competitive proposals. Therefore, no solicitation document exists for this requirement. Any firm believing that they can fulfill the requirement may be considered by the agency. Interested parties may identify their interest and capabilities in response to this synopsis. All questions and/or comments regarding this notice shall be addressed in writing to the Contracting Officer Jennifer.Koons@hq.dhs.gov by September 7, 2026 by 10:00 AM Eastern. Questions by phone will not be considered.

title: 3ID G2 DAQ ICIDS Services & Maintenace
description: Action: Sources Sought Notice for Market Research Agency: Department of the Army Office: MICC-Fort Stewart Notice ID: W9124M-26-R-ICIDS Classification Code: J - Maintenance, repair & rebuilding of equipment Product Service Code (PSC): J063 - Maintenance, Repair, and Rebuilding of Equipment- Alarm, Signal, and Security Detection Systems NAICS Code: 561621 - Security Systems Services (Except Locksmiths) Size Standard: $25.0 Million 1. Synopsis This is a Sources Sought notice for market research purposes only. This is not a solicitation for proposals, proposal abstracts, or quotations. The purpose of this notice is to obtain information regarding the availability and capability of qualified sources to perform the services described below. The Government is seeking to identify qualified vendors, particularly small businesses, who are capable of meeting the Government's requirements. The Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this notice or to otherwise pay for the information solicited. The information received will be used to determine the appropriate acquisition strategy for a future procurement. 2. Requirement Description The Mission and Installation Contracting Command (MICC) at Fort Stewart, GA, on behalf of the 3d Infantry Division (3ID) G2, has a requirement for non-personal services to provide comprehensive maintenance, emergency repair, and cybersecurity sustainment for the Government's existing DAQ Electronics Starwatch� Security Management System (SMS) and Integrated Commercial Intrusion Detection System (ICIDS). The place of performance is Fort Stewart and Hunter Army Airfield, Georgia. The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month base year with three (3) 12-month option periods, projected to begin on or around the first quarter of Fiscal Year 2027. 3. Mandatory Requirements This requirement includes two (2) mandatory, non-negotiable constraints. Interested vendors MUST be able to meet both requirements at the time of proposal submission for any future solicitation. DAQ Electronics OEM Certification: The contractor must be an authorized and certified partner/integrator for DAQ Electronics security products. All technicians performing work under the contract must hold current factory certifications from DAQ Electronics to service proprietary Starwatch� SMS and ICIDS hardware and software. Facility Security Clearance: The contractor must possess a valid Top Secret (TS) Facility Clearance at the time of proposal submission, and all personnel performing on-site work must have, at a minimum, an adjudicated Secret clearance, with the Program Manager and key technicians requiring TS/SCI eligibility. This is required due to the necessity for unescorted access to Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIFs). 4. Requested Information from Industry Interested parties are requested to provide a capabilities statement package (not to exceed 5 pages) that demonstrates the ability to perform the services described herein. The package must be submitted via email to the points of contact listed in Section 5 of this notice. Please include the following information in your response: Company Information: Company Name, Address, and Point of Contact (including email and phone number). UEI Number and CAGE Code. Socio-economic status under the specified NAICS code 561621 (e.g., Small Business, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business, HUBZone, 8(a), Woman-Owned Small Business, etc.). Capability Questions (Must be answered): Question 1: Can your company perform the services described in the requirement overview (Section 2)? Please provide a brief narrative describing your company�s experience maintaining and repairing ICIDS systems, specifically the DAQ Electronics Starwatch� platform. Question 2: Does your company currently hold a valid Top Secret (TS) Facility Clearance? Question 3: If this requirement is set aside for small businesses, will your company be able to perform at least 50 percent of the cost of the contract performance with its own employees, in accordance with FAR 52.219-14, Limitations on Subcontracting? 5. Submission Details All responses must be submitted via email no later than September 7, 2026, at 10:00 AM Eastern Standard Time. Primary Point of Contact: SSG Mykola Iudin Contract Specialist Mykola.iudin.mil@army.mil Secondary Point of Contact: MSG Keandre D. Malone Contracting Officer Keandre.d.malone.mil@army.mil Disclaimer: This Sources Sought is issued for market research purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation. All information received in response to this notice that is marked as proprietary will be handled accordingly. The Government reserves the right to use the information received to inform an acquisition strategy, which may include a small business set-aside or an unrestricted, full and open competition. Submitting a response to this notice does not guarantee that a firm will be invited to participate in any future solicitation.
